title: Strategic insights for entrepreneurship and business growth in the export sector
core_idea: Conduct a decade-long (2010–2020) analysis of Santander, Colombia's export sector using regional opportunity map data, financial analysis, and multiple linear regression on 128 exporting firms to identify the variables that influence firm growth and to inform strategic development in the context of post-pandemic recovery and ongoing trade negotiations.
tldr: A decade-long empirical study of Santander's export sector using financial data and regression analysis to uncover factors influencing export firm growth and guide strategic development amid post-pandemic and trade-agreement contexts.
